column1: # Reading corpus for the reference workloads (design §8.6), fetched by fetch.sh.
# Entries and pins come from docs/reviews/evidence/q2/q2-usage.md §0.
# Columns, tab-separated; "-" marks an empty field:
#   kind     git (whole tree), git-sparse (only the listed paths), or tarball
#   pin      full commit SHA (git kinds) or SHA-256 of the tarball
#   paths    comma-separated paths of interest, relative to corpus/<name>/;
#            the checkout for git-sparse, informational otherwise
# Not listed, though q2-usage §0 read them:
#   TAU (tau2): excluded by q2-usage because it wraps every routine.
#   lamellar-runtime: makes no OpenSHMEM calls; its "shmem" is POSIX shared memory.
#   openshmem_rs: Rust bindings with no application using them.
# deepep, pplx-kernels, triton-distributed, and pytorch call NVSHMEM, not
# OpenSHMEM (triton-distributed also wraps rocSHMEM). They are kept as evidence
# for the put-with-signal idiom behind U4; no trace cites them.
